title: Subjunctive in exhortation
subtitle: Read “let us …” as a shared appeal.
overview: The first-person plural subjunctive often functions as a hortatory appeal: “let us ….” It invites a group response rather than merely describing action.
Identify the speaker’s inclusive audience and the grounds or contrast that surround the appeal.

sections.title: Hortatory signals
rows: let us hold fast the confession

items.grc: ἀγαπητοί, ἀγαπῶμεν ἀλλήλους, ὅτι ἡ ἀγάπη ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ ἐστιν.
items.en: Beloved, let us love one another, because love is from God.

items.grc: μὴ καθεύδωμεν ὡς οἱ λοιποί, ἀλλὰ γρηγορῶμεν.
items.en: Let us not sleep as the rest do, but let us stay awake.
